rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named; mood-floor 8+/10 on TEACHING beats, setup beats exempt
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sim trace (regenerated this pass): single teaching phase mood_score 8, close mood_score 8. Session-open widget (lines 3–9, /rename m2-plan-mode) is mechanical setup and correctly mood-exempt per the sim's own note. The new deferral bullet on the close slide doesn't drop the score — reasoned through below at §2.

The new bullet — 'What the plan doesn't decide, the agent decides mid-run ... and you will not notice' — is a general, third-person mechanism claim (a hidden-decision risk you can't yet see), not an accusation that the reader already erred. Harm this rule guards against (shame framing) is absent: no second-person blame, no reference to a mistake the student has made. The maintainer's own accept-note (2026-08-08) explicitly defends 'you will not notice' as the true epistemic claim ('a wrong design call reads as progress while it is being made') rather than a punitive one — confirms the same read independently.
